notes.title: Card Game Island Dev Log
notes.content:
Hey, card sharks!

If you watched the MIX Next showcase a few weeks ago, you would have seen the trailer that the next free major update, Card Game Island, will be available on December 8th! If you missed the trailer, you can view it here!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k2CRCtKyJJc 

Two big changes coming with the update! First, Card Game Island allows you to actually try your hand at Warlock in an endgame, single player card battler. Second, King of Games mode enables the most punishing version of Kardboard Kings’ difficulty yet!! Let’s get into some details, shall we?

[h2]Card Game Island[/h2]
The fabled home of the best Warlock players in the world, Card Game Island is where the best of the best duke it out in some of Warlock’s most important duels. To get there, you can join by buying an airplane ticket at the shop on Mondays. When you buy your ticket and end the day, you’ll be taken to Card Game Island, instead of the next day in the store.

Once at Card Game Island, you’ll have the opportunity to play the game of Warlock. Starting with a random deck, you’ll be able to add or remove cards after each match at set points on the map! As you move through the map, you’ll have the choice to visit shops or start battles and you’ll have a little bit of information about the state of the battle when you arrive. Every battle includes a passive effect strengthening certain types of cards. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38062682/552bc4f3b6db2d94b51536bc1c5bb54ef713885e.jpg[/img]

Each battle both you and your opponent start by drawing five cards. Warlock is set up in two basic phases, the main phase where you can play your cards, and the battle phase where you attack your opponents creatures.

On your turn, you’ll first have the option to play your cards in the creature zone or support zone. The cards you play in the creature zone are face up and the main cards to attack your opponent. The cards in the support zone are played face down and support the creatures in the creature zone. Also in this phase, if you have warlock tokens, you can activate your legendary cards to trigger powerful effects on the battlefield. One such effect, for instance, eliminates all the creature cards on the field.

Once you are finished playing your cards, you will start the combat phase. The combat phase is where you can attack your opponents cards! Each creature can attack once. When attacking, select which card you’d like to attack with and their target. There are two different conditions you want to look at when attacking a card, the power level of both cards and the type of both cards. If your card has a higher power level then your opponents, then you gain an advantage as the creatures fight each other.

There are three types of abilities in Warlock: Beauty, Brain, and Brawn. Beauty beats brain, brains beats brawn and brawn beats beauty. If your ability type beats your opponent’s then you gain an advantage over your opponent’s creature. If your creature attacking has the advantage over your opponent’s creature then you destroy your opponent’s card. Draws in the battle keeps both creatures on the field. Destroying a creature adds its power total to your score, displayed at the top of the screen. The first to maximize their score wins.

During the combat phase is when your support cards come into play! If your creature that is battling shares the same color in the support zone you can play that support card to increase your creature’s strength or change the type of ability that creature is during the battle. Make sure that when you place down support cards that the color matches one of your creatures on the field as if they don’t share colors with a creature on the field they can’t support your cards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38062682/204a88a9ab2a016e85a9dce8f0d650858fb8fb86.jpg[/img]

After your combat phase you will draw cards based on how many creatures of different colors are in your creature zone plus one card. So if you end the turn with three different colored creatures on the field you draw four cards.

The match continues until one of the players reaches the score limit. You gain points by destroying your opponent’s creature cards. Their strength after applying bonuses from support and field bonuses is how many points you gain towards your score.

[h2]King of Games[/h2]
King of Games is the hard mode of Kardboard Games! You can turn it on and off on the save selection screen and turn them on and off any time during your playthrough on the save selection screen.


King of Games adds these extra rules to your game, looking to really challenge the best shopkeepers out there
[list]
[*] Weekly Taxes - Every Monday you pay taxes which is calculated based on your sales
[*] Reputation drains over time
[*] Tougher shop goals
[*] More extreme piece changes to trends and ban lists
[/list]
Also after each day you will be graded on how well you did based on reputation gained, customers served, requests filled, and money spent on cards and decorations.

Card Game Island will be available December 8th and I’m excited to get this update in your hands!

-Riv Otter

notes.title: Kardboard Kings Season 2 Launches!
notes.content:
Hey, card sharks! 

The second big content update for [i]Kardboard Kings[/i] is now live! 

We've got three new card sets and a brand new (much requested) gameplay feature to help endgame players churn through their massive collections. 

As a note for any achievement hunters out there, all achievements referencing card sets (such as collecting a shiny of every card in the game) will be updated in 0.7.9 to require the new card sets as well. 

We’ll be going dark for a while until the next big content patch is ready but… boy let me tell you, it’s gonna be a doozy. Without spoiling anything, I just wanna say… the #1 most requested gameplay feature is coming to [i]Kardboard Kings[/i]. It’s happening. 

[h3]New Card Sets[/h3]
We’ve added 3 new card sets to the game, [i]Noodle Love[/i], [i]Raw Sugar[/i] and [i]Pushing Up Daisies[/i] from the artists [url=https://www.instagram.com/raindemitree/?hl=en]raindemitree[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/r.ruscus/?hl=en]Robert Ruszczyk[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/ungfio/?hl=en]ungfio[/url] respectively. These new cards look absolutely stunning and I hope you’re excited to add them to your collection!

[h3]The Bargain Bin[/h3]
A highly requested feature from deep endgame collectors, the Bargain Bin is going to help you dump your cards without needing to risk a clearance sale or spend days flooding the shop with dead weight. Instead, the Bargan Bin will let you drop any card in for $0.25, making it nice and easy for you to clear out all the cards you’d rather not worry about selling. 

[h3]Buddy Gets Rich: Bargain Hunting[/h3]
And last but not least, if there’s a new patch, that typically means there’s a new episode of Buddy Gets Rich on the horizon! I’ll be playing at 11AM Pacific this Friday, August 5th. You can feel free to give our [url=https://twitch.tv/akuparagames]Twitch stream[/url] a follow to make sure you get the go live notification! 

As ever, thank you for your support and please feel free to report any issues to us on [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1298480/discussions/]the Steam forums[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/rgUEch9r5X]the Kardboard Kings Discord![/url]

notes.title: Kardboard Kings - 0.5.11 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey, card sharks! 

We've got another promised update out for you to play around with! This update pairs some low-hanging quality of life changes that we've seen folks ask for as well as another big round of bugfixes to stamp out any issues that have persisted since launch. The headline changes are that Clearance sales sell your cheapest cards first, Declan keeps coming to the shop even after you get all the decorations, and customers chance to buy cards now scales according to their median price rather than a fixed price. 

As a note, if you'd like to see some of these changes take place, you're going to need to cycle a new day to get them to trigger. Some stuff you'll see right on loading up the game but some things will need a new save trigger to kick in, as it were. 

Here's the full list of changes: 

[h3]Quality of life/balance changes[/h3]:
[list]
[*]Clearance sales now sell your cheapest cards first.
[*]Cards in inventory are now marked if they will be sold at an upcoming clearance sale.
[*]Declan now continues to come in after all decorations are unlocked and will reward you with boosters.
[*]Reputation gain/lost from requests capped at 10.
[*]Added a card diagram to the magazine.
[*]Customers chance to buy cards now scaled with median price of card rarity.
[*]Replacing a card in your binder with a shiny will now return you the original card.
[*]Banlist events now change card prices more aggressively to try prevent the same cards from appearing on the banlist.
[*]Card colours now shown in phone news items.
[*]Card price decreases have been made more intense to try prevent card prices inflating over time.
[*]Speed of end of day price changes now scale with number to decrease waiting time.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed shop fail event not triggering.
[*]Improved performance for huge card collections.
[*]Fixed incorrect calendar descriptions for some news events
[*]Prevented phone news items occurring at negative days and not disappearing.
[*]Rare impossible requests will not generate.
[*]Set posters now no longer unlock prematurely.
[/list]

If you're still having any issues with the game, please feel free to continue reporting them to me! I'm happy to shoot those reports off to the developers!

notes.title: Kardboard Kings - 0.5.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey, Card Sharks! 

We’re pushing a small update that has a huge bugfix in it that I wanna take a minute to break down for you. We know that there are a number of players who pushed deep into the endgame and found issues with Postie Gustaf delivering mail to you. Of primary concern, this softlocked player’s games because he’d eventually arrive with no mail and you couldn’t exit the mail screen. Of secondary concern, this means players could tank their shop into the ground by losing all their money and cards. 

Both of these problems are fixed in today’s build. Posting Gustaf will be arriving and he’ll be arriving with all of the backlog packages you ordered. Fair warning, there will be a ton of mail (as you can see in the screenshot below) but it’s the most important bug we’ve been working on since we released less than a week ago.

notes.title: Kardboard Kings - 0.5.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey, card sharks!

A big update is coming today with a huge focus on solving tons of bugs that you’ve reported to us over the weekend. Obviously, we’re still less than a week out from launch so this update isn’t focused on bringing some of the expansive changes that we’ve seen players asking for. Our focus here is instead on nailing as many of the disruptions in the way of people enjoying the game. 

If you just wanna buy, sell, trade and collect the cards of Warlock, a ton of issues that have been in your way are solved in this patch. The headliners here include clamping down huge reputation swings, fixing the unselectable gbay items issue, and cleaning up some rare issues in the deep, deep late game. Notable exceptions to fixes, however, include a rare issue where Postie Gustav gets overwhelmed by deliveries and doesn’t spawn, which we’re working on fixing later this week. 

If you were hit by some of the hardcore bugs fixed in this patch, you should be able to pick up right where you left off without any issue. That said, it’s possible that certain bugs have unforeseen knock-on effects even after the core issue is fixed. If any new issues do crop up, feel free to report them to me. I’ll want to take care of it as quickly as I can.

Here are the full patch notes:

Feature Changes:
[list]
[*]  Clamped the maximum and minimum amount of reputation gained/lost by tags to 15
[*]  Made rep loss sound less attention-grabbing
[*]  Prevented viewing requests during dialogue to remove bugs where previously impossible conversation topics would become possible
[*]  Harry and his buds only enjoy greasy food and beers once every four days.
[*]  Improved performance of collection tab when having ~100 cards
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]  Fixed bottom row of gbay items being unselectable
[*]  Prevented tag menu from opening in states it should not by holding hotkey
[*]  Fixed a reputation bombing bug from tags
[*]  Fixed Kei deck comparison event softlocking the game
[*]  Fixed bug involving hovering a currently held tag over the tag menu to get a magnet tag
[*]  Fixed card alignment issues in collection when having over 20 cards
[*]  Fixed queens letter text overflow
[*]  Fixed game breaking late game bug caused by having 1-3 decorations left to unlock (what an edge case!)
[*]  Fixed bug caused by placing magnet tags on all cards in stands
[*]  Fixed shiny alignment issue in binder
[*]  Fixed card title offset in set release UI
[*]  Fixed previous calendar event texts and icons rendering incorrectly after loading game
[*]  Many spelling and punctuation fixes
[/list]

We’ve got more bug fixes coming down the line as well for harder- to-fix issues that are taking more time, so there will be another update coming in the not-too-distant future. Past that, we’re looking at ways to make the deep endgame a little more enjoyable for those of you hunting the super rare achievements in the game. 

If any other issues crop up, feel free to let me know in the Steam Discussion forums! Otherwise, I hope you’re enjoying Kardboard Kings!

-Buddy

notes.title: Win a Kardboard Kings Key by Solving the Legendary Card Puzzles!
notes.content:
Hey, card sharks! 

Kardboard Kings releases next week! And as usual, we’re running a number of cool events coinciding with launch, one of which is the Kardboard Kings Legendary Card Giveaway. This one is a little bit complicated, so I wanted to lay out the rules a week in advance just so everyone’s ready. 

Here’s the overview:

Solve an emoji puzzle in either [url=discord.gg/akuparagames]the Akupara Games[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/A8gBB2vvGX]Kardboard Kings Discord[/url] by arranging 24 emoji to create a Kardboard Kings legendary card. The first player to solve a puzzle will receive a Steam key when Kardboard Kings launches on February 10th! 

Here are the details:

[list]
[*] The emoji puzzle is split up into 24 randomized emoji. 
[*] The emoji can be combined in the Discord to make the appearance of a seamless legendary card. 
[*] A practice puzzle has been added to both Discords if anyone wants to test Discord’s emoji functionality. 
[*] The emoji puzzles will go live on Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday of next week, February 7th, 8th and 9th. 
[*] The emoji puzzle will be added to the Discords 12PM Pacific (3PM Eastern.) 
[*] As soon as the emoji puzzle is added, it can be solved and the first person to solve it per day wins. 
[*] The Kardboard Kings and Akupara Discords will each get one unique card everyday, which means there are two keys to be claimed everyday and six keys to be claimed over all three days. 
[*] A player can only win once and can’t win more than one key. 
[*] Winning entries must be in the #kardboard-kings channel in the Akupara Discord.
[*] Winning entries must in the #card-games-chat channel in the Kardboard Kings Discord.
[*] Winning entries must be the entire legendary card with no seams, including spaces!
[/list]

If you have any questions about specific aspects of the giveaway, please feel free to comment on this news item or reach out to me in either Discord! Good luck to everyone that competes!

notes.title: Kardboard Kings releases February 10th!
notes.content:
[h2]Buy trading cards low and sell them high in Kardboard Kings on February 10th![/h2]

You are Harry Hsu, a young man who recently inherited a card shop from his father, a former champion of the famous card game "Warlock." With the shop’s reputation on the line, you start working behind the counter, juggling the locals' requests while trying to familiarize yourself with owning a shop. 

Your guide, Giuseppe, a fast-talking Cockatoo, helps you in your buying and selling journey - securing cards of various rarities to top collectors or helping an enthusiastic customer from the neighbourhood.

[previewyoutube=06pM3Wabl9o;full][/previewyoutube]

Here’s the best stuff in store over the next few weeks:

[h3]Kardboard Kings Radio[/h3]
On Monday January 31st, you’ll be able to hear the Original Game Soundtrack of Kardboard Kings with a special twist! Tune in to the full length recording of the best damn radio station in all of Parakeet Bay, Radio PKB hosted by Orion Duran. We’ll also be debuting the Kardboard Kings soundtrack the same day so you can pick up your favorite tracks as soon as you hear them.

[h3]Legendary Card Puzzles![/h3]
Before you can unfold the mystery of the legendary cards in Kardboard Kings, solve the Legendary Card puzzles in the [url=https://discord.gg/AngXUVH3f7]Kardboard Kings[/url] and [url=http://discord.gg/akuparagames]Akupara Games[/url] Discord servers! The week before the game launches, we’ll be holding a contest on both Discords for players to get Kardboard Kings keys on launch. A series of emotes will be added to the server and the first player to decipher the puzzle wins the key! Puzzles begin on February 7th!

[h3]The Kardboard Kings Launch Party[/h3]
As ever, the day that Kardboard Kings goes live, we’ll be celebrating on the Akupara Games Twitch page with the developers behind the game and an all-day stream to see if we can collect every card in the game! Tune in at 11AM Pacific on February 10th to be a part of the action and feel free to race Buddy to 100% completion. 

[h3]Buddy Gets Rich![/h3]
Do you wanna make big money flipping Warlock cards? Do you wanna cut good deals for all your friends and get a rep for being the best card shop in town? How do new sets, tournaments, clearance sales, and booster drafts work? Buddy will be breaking down the finer details of Kardboard King’s mechanics in this video series starting Friday, February 11th, the day after the game launches!

“Often shopkeeping mechanics act as a secondary mechanic used to supplement a more central mechanic within games. We wanted to bring shopkeeping to the front and centre and ended up taking a unique approach to designing the core shopkeeping gameplay.” - Oscar Brittain and Rob Gross, Creators of Kardboard Kings

[b]Features: [/b]
[list]
[*] 💸 Buy, Trade, Sell or Collect - Buy low, sell high, or store in your card binder just to flex.
[*] 🎴 Cards, Cards, Cards - From ripping open boosters to buying singles off various sites, discover over a hundred cards of varying rarities (plus shiny variants!), featuring illustrations from talented artists.
[*] 📈 Unpredictable Market Conditions - Reprints, ban lists, kids' meal promos, theft targeting, and church condemnations - you know, the usual suspect - all affect the price of your inventory.
[*] ❤️ Win the Hearts Within Your Community - Befriend the locals, hear their requests, and help feed their addictive collection hobby or elevate their game; they just might help your store become the best in town. 
[*] 🏬 Create Your Perfect Shop - New management means new branding - create your dream shop with a catalogue of walls, flooring, and knickknacks; everyone loves a good chia pet, right?
[*] 🔍 An Intriguing Story - All is not what it seems on the seaside! A sudden appearance of a mysterious patron has you wondering why they trust you with more than just information.
[/list]

–

If you haven’t already, feel free to come hang out with us in [url=https://discord.gg/AngXUVH3f7]the Kardboard Kings Discord![/url]

notes.content:
Hey, Collectors!

If you caught the announcement in the [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iYCrI-GbJzA]Indie Houses keynote[/url], Akupara Games will be publishing Kardboard Kings and that means a lot of very cool things down the line (like featuring Kardboard Kings at events and in the press and a bunch of other places.)
